solution._comment: AWS Solution identity: the single source of truth for both reporting mechanisms, the CloudFormation stack Description (deployment counting) and the AWS SDK User-Agent suffix (API usage attribution). 'secondary_ids' are carried in the stack Description only, not in the User-Agent. Not a per-run knob: bump 'version' when cutting a release and otherwise leave it alone. Read only by cdk/lib/solution.ts and pidtwin/src/pidtwin/solution.py, always from this file, never from cdk/config.json. See those two files for the exact formats.
solution.name: Guidance for Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams Digitization on AWS
